device.voice.hint: Dictation happens on this iPhone: the audio never leaves the phone. When you stop, Clara proposes and nothing is recorded until you confirm.
device.voice.unavailable.unsupportedLoca: Dictation: this iPhone does not recognize Clara's language.
device.voice.unavailable.noOnDevice: Dictation: this iPhone can't recognize Clara's language offline, and Clara only uses dictation that happens on the phone.
device.voice.unavailable.denied: Dictation: Clara doesn't have permission for the microphone or speech recognition. You can allow it in the iPhone Settings app › Clara.
device.voice.unavailable.restricted: Dictation: speech recognition is restricted on this iPhone.
device.voice.unavailable.failed: Dictation: couldn't check whether it's available.
device.voice.error.noOnDevice: This language can't be dictated offline on this iPhone.
device.voice.error.denied: No permission for the microphone or speech recognition. You can allow it in the iPhone Settings app › Clara.
device.scan.hint: The document camera reads up to 5 receipts in a row on this iPhone; each one is proposed separately for you to review.
device.scan.skipped: Only 5 receipts are read at a time: {count} were left out. Scan them in another round.
device.scan.error.unavailable: This iPhone doesn't have the document camera. Use “{photo}”.
device.scan.error.busy: The document camera is already open.
device.scan.tooBig: A receipt couldn't be reduced to a reasonable size and wasn't added.
device.ai.badge: Suggested by AI on your iPhone
device.ai.used: Proposed by this iPhone's AI, without sending anything: each line quotes your text and the amount is read by the usual parser. Review them.
device.ai.aiFailed: This iPhone's AI didn't answer in time or didn't quote your text: the usual parser was used.
device.ai.aiFewer: This iPhone's AI proposed fewer transactions than the usual parser: the usual one was used.
device.ai.field.amount: Amount suggested by the AI (your text doesn't give it in figures): check it.
device.ai.field.date: Date suggested by the AI: check it.
device.ai.receipt.total: Total suggested by this iPhone's AI, from the receipt line “{line}”.
device.ai.receipt.date: Receipt date suggested by this iPhone's AI.
device.ai.receipt.merchant: Merchant suggested by this iPhone's AI.
device.settings.title: On this iPhone
device.settings.voiceOn: Dictation: on the iPhone, without sending the audio.
device.settings.ocr: Receipt photos: the text is read on the iPhone (Vision); the photo never leaves the phone.
device.settings.scanOn: Document camera: up to 5 receipts in a row.
device.settings.scanOff: Document camera: not available on this iPhone; photos still work.
device.settings.aiOn: Apple Intelligence AI on this iPhone: available.
device.settings.aiOff.unsupportedOS: iPhone AI: needs iOS 26 or later, or this install of Clara doesn't include it.
device.settings.aiOff.deviceNotEligible: iPhone AI: this iPhone model doesn't have Apple Intelligence.
device.settings.aiOff.appleIntelligenceN: iPhone AI: Apple Intelligence is turned off in the iPhone Settings app.
device.settings.aiOff.modelNotReady: iPhone AI: the model isn't ready yet (it's downloading or getting ready). Check again later.
device.settings.aiOff.unsupportedLanguag: iPhone AI: doesn't support Clara's language.
device.settings.aiToggle: Use this iPhone's AI in the assistant
device.settings.aiToggleHint: Optional and off to start with. It runs on the iPhone and sends nothing. It only proposes: each line must quote your text, the amount is read by the usual parser and nothing is recorded until you confirm. Remembered on this device.
device.ai.onNote: This iPhone's AI is on: it proposes first and is checked against your text; if it doesn't answer in time, the fixed rules are used. It sends nothing.
